display.purpose: The name, once, at the top of the sheet (and the 404 heading); the opening peak. 22pt in print.

contact.purpose: The large copyable email in the Contact close; the page's last peak. 14pt in print.

title.purpose: Every section heading, sentence-case foreground sans; also the Danish word. 13pt in print.

lead.purpose: The role line (muted), the Currently paragraph and the contact lede.

item-title.purpose: Titles of ruled list items; underline on hover when a link.

body.purpose: Prose, stack names, skill values, book and tile titles (500); the intro's Currently label.

small.purpose: Artist, author and note lines; Danish meaning and example.

meta.purpose: Mono voice for dates, places, durations, stacks, contact links and tile caption values. Muted by default.

control.purpose: Mono text inside dock and copy buttons, the skip link, the contribution caption.

micro.purpose: Mono badges, preview chips, month labels, the Danish pronunciation, missing-cover initials.

shadows.name: dock-float

shadows.name: cover-rest

shadows.name: cover-rest-small
shadows.purpose: Soft contact shadow under shelf book covers.

shadows.name: live-halo
shadows.purpose: The ember-soft ring around the 6px live dot; a halo, not a shadow. Breathes to 5px and fades.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Exponential-out easing for the clock second hand (200ms), the live-dot breath and the preview card rise.

motion.name: breathe
motion.purpose: Live-dot halo expands from 3px to 5px and fades; marks live state only.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Preview card enters from 6px below with opacity 0 when the active project changes.

motion.name: fade
motion.purpose: Colour and background fades on dock and copy buttons.

motion.name: theme-fade
motion.purpose: Body background and colour on theme toggle; tile, preview and project-row border or fill changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion every transition and animation, including the live-dot breath, is disabled and smooth scroll is off.

breakpoints.name: narrow

narrative.overview:
The page is a single sheet of near-black paper read top to bottom like a CV, and it prints as one. It opens on a large name and closes on a large email address; between those two peaks every section is a plain sentence-case title over a ruled list. Nothing on the sheet asks for attention except the things that are actually alive: one row of small working instruments under the intro (a ticking Copenhagen clock with the weather, a Last.fm now-playing card, the book being read, a Danish word of the day) and a year of real GitHub contributions further down. Proof is shown as working things, not claimed.

Hierarchy is carried by type and rhythm alone. A seven-step ramp runs from an 11px mono micro size to a fluid display name, with clear jumps between steps, and sections stand 96px apart so each reads as its own page of the notebook. Prose is Geist Sans; every date, duration, place, stack and control is Geist Mono. The build rejects the loud portfolio hero with imagery, decorative gradients, the card grid, and the transit line of an earlier build. Depth comes from one tonal step (ground to surface) and 1px hairlines.

Colour is a discipline rather than a palette. One ember accent exists and is spent only on live state: the second hand, the breathing "now" dot, the contribution cells, the copy confirmation, text selection and the focus ring. A light scheme and a print scheme re-map every token so the same structure survives on white paper.
keyCharacteristics: One 680px column, centred; the only thing outside it is a project preview card on screens of 1100px and wider.
Two type voices: Geist Sans for prose, labels and peaks; Geist Mono for data and controls.
Two typographic peaks, the name at the top and the contact email at the bottom; everything between is title, body and meta.
Ruled lists (1px hairline top and bottom) carry every section; tiles and the preview card are the only bordered, rounded surfaces.
One accent, ember, reserved for things that are live right now.
Three schemes (dark, light, print) driven by the same custom properties; dark is the default.
Motion is confined to instruments and live state: the clock ticks, the live dot breathes, the preview card rises; everything else is a 150–200ms colour fade.

rules.name: The Live-Only Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember marks something that is true right now: a ticking second hand, a playing track, a current role, a commit this year, a just-copied address. It never colours a heading, a link, a badge, a language dot, a button at rest, or decoration. If it is not live, it is foreground or muted.

rules.name: The Two-Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px hairlines at exactly two strengths: hairline for rules and resting borders, hairline-strong for hover, outlines that must hold their own (badges), and the dock chrome. No other border colours exist.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: If a string is a date, a duration, a place, a stack, a pronunciation or a control label, it is Geist Mono and muted. Prose never goes mono. The one address that goes sans is the large contact email, because there it is the page's closing statement.

rules.name: The Two-Peaks Rule
rules.body: The sheet has exactly two large moments: the display name that opens it and the contact email that closes it. Everything between tops out at the 22px title; new surfaces do not add a third peak.

rules.name: The Objects-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only things that are objects cast shadows: the floating dock and book covers. Tiles, cards, rows, badges and buttons stay flat; their depth is a border or fill change.

dos: Do set every section heading as a 22px weight-500 sentence-case title over a ruled list; add a section, not a card, when content grows.
Do separate sections with --block-gap (96px, 72px under 640px) and keep --label-gap (20px) under titles.
Do take sizes from the type tokens (--text-display through --text-micro) and radii from the radius tokens rather than inventing new values.
Do set dates, durations, places, stacks and control text in Geist Mono and muted.
Do reach for hairline first and hairline-strong only for hover, badges and dock chrome.
Do spend ember only on live state, and mark "now" with the breathing 6px live dot.
Do add new widgets as 180px-tall, 14px-radius surface tiles in the widget row, with a muted caption pinned to the bottom.
Do re-map new colours in all three schemes (dark root, [data-theme="light"], @media print) and hide interactive or live-only elements in print.
Do give every live or fetched element a quiet fallback line instead of an empty box.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion (all transitions and animations off).
donts: Don't add a third typographic peak; nothing between the name and the contact email exceeds the 22px title.
Don't set section titles in uppercase, tracked caps, or as eyebrows above another heading.
Don't use ember for links, headings, badges, language dots, buttons at rest, or decoration.
Don't wrap tools or skills in pills; the stack is names with small marks on a ruled grid.
Don't add shadows to tiles, cards, rows or buttons; only the dock and book covers cast them.
Don't box list content in cards or add vertical rules; lists are separated by horizontal hairlines only.
Don't underline links at rest; underline appears on hover only.
Don't use icon fonts or glyph characters as icons; icons are inline SVG.
